scope: Review-first Greenhouse route recognition, privacy-safe form metadata, native field validation with human resume, and hash-verified resume and cover-letter selection on synthetic loopback pages.
implemented: Normalize supported HTTPS Greenhouse job routes to one canonical boards.greenhouse.io URL and reject untrusted hosts, credentials, ports, mismatched provider data, and malformed paths.
Use the shared bounded analyzer to read allowlisted form metadata without returning current values; unknown, ambiguous, sensitive, or credential fields require human review.

Check browser-native validity without reading or returning applicant values. Invalid forms stop before file selection with a fixed review status; manual completion resumes preparation without adapter autofill. File inputs are validated through the immutable document snapshots.

Select prepared resume and cover-letter snapshots only on HTTP loopback fixtures. Re-analyze to reject stale forms, require exactly one recognized file field per document, revalidate immutable PDF bytes, and verify selected browser bytes by digest.
Keep public ATS document upload, live form interaction, and submission unsupported. Fixture upload does not click or submit the form.

validation.detail: 31 unit, integration, and Chromium tests passed. Includes a red-green regression for required-field validation: invalid required input produced a review stop and no selected files; manual completion resumed fixture upload; the validation response contained no field values. Existing origin, uncertainty, exact-byte, persistence metadata, and no-submit controls also passed.
Expected RED reproduced: upload returned without raising GREENHOUSE_REQUIRED_FIELDS_INVALID for a blank required email field. The same regression passed in the post-change 31-test run.

not_run: Direct UI-to-Greenhouse-adapter wiring and a connected Greenhouse attempt are outside this lane's claimed paths; no Greenhouse confirmation, audit/readback, or restart recovery is claimed.
Web UI build and connected UI restart/readback for this adapter were not run in this validation checkpoint.
Live Greenhouse requests, public ATS uploads, external submission, GitHub-hosted tests and hosted reviews.
limitations: The adapter is not mounted into shared API/UI/worker composition; serial integration work is still required.
The upload method is fixture-only and limited to two recognized file inputs, resume and cover letter. It cannot interact with a public ATS.
Issue #346 and parent MJ-REQ-122 remain OPEN/PARTIAL; this evidence does not represent the broader workflow as accepted.
